Settings.Name: Open the roadmap
Settings.Description: Opens the Companion & Romance Roadmap overlay.

Settings.Name: Toggle roadmap
Settings.Description: Opens or closes the roadmap overlay. F8 is avoided on purpose: it is the game's Quickload key.

Settings.Name: Spoilers for later acts
Settings.Description: How much to reveal about steps that belong to an act you have not reached yet.

Settings.Name: Hide completed steps
Settings.Description: Hide steps that are done or do not apply to your playthrough.

Settings.Name: Show how steps are tracked
Settings.Description: Show the game flag or journal entry each step is detected from.

Settings.Name: Companion portraits
Settings.Description: Show a small picture next to each companion (the game's own Photo Mode stickers). It changes with their approval, your romance and whether they are alive. Turn this off if the pictures do not appear.

Settings.Name: Esc closes the roadmap
Settings.Description: Pressing Esc while the roadmap is open closes it instead of opening the game menu.

Settings.Name: Window opacity
Settings.Description: Background opacity of the roadmap window.

Settings.Name: Step notifications
Settings.Description: Show a short notice when a tracked step is completed or missed.

Settings.Name: Notify for every step
Settings.Description: By default only romance and important steps produce notifications.

Settings.Name: Warn me before a point of no return
Settings.Description: When the game asks whether you are ready to move on (the Shadowfell, the Mind Flayer Colony, leaving for Baldur's Gate, the Lower City, the Morphic Pool), show what is still open right then.

Settings.Name: Remind me to knock out, not kill
Settings.Description: When a fight starts with a companion you can only recruit by knocking them out (Minthara, Minsc), remind you to use Non-Lethal Attacks.

Settings.Name: Where notices appear
Settings.Description: Where the roadmap's notices show up on screen. A sample notice appears when you change it. Choose Custom to place them with the two sliders below.

Settings.Name: Custom position: across
Settings.Description: Only used with the Custom position. 0 puts notices against the left edge of the screen, 100 against the right edge.

Settings.Name: Custom position: down
Settings.Description: Only used with the Custom position. 0 puts notices at the top of the screen, 100 at the bottom.
